lessons.claim: If RUN.builder's sample() returns the whole N-particle array as a dict for every sample, RUN.execute stacks it as it stands into (n_samp,N,...) and stores it in observables.npz -- in trap-2d-5um a file that had been 448KB became 148MB (330x). Derived quantities (histograms, ⟨x²⟩ and so on) have to be accumulated immediately in the sample() closure, and only the parts that need the raw array (C(t), the PSD) filled into a small pre-allocated subset, for the original memory and disk usage to hold.
